entries.name: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME
entries.reason: Docker Compose's own environment variable; the stack-down helper explains why it must not aim the default project, and our code never spells it

entries.name: ERR_SERVER_NOT_RUNNING
entries.reason: A Node.js error code, owned by Node; the local-server helper says closing a stopped server is a no-op and not this error

entries.name: ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED
entries.reason: A Node.js error code, owned by Node; the TCP relay test names the failure a late write to a dead upstream raises

entries.name: SORT_MERGE
entries.reason: A MongoDB query-plan stage name, owned by the database; the test says it is streaming and passes the position-read gate

entries.name: SCREAMING_SNAKE
entries.reason: The name of an identifier shape the docs gate measured and ruled out, written in code font as a label and not a constant

entries.name: PROXY_SYMBOL
entries.reason: A placeholder for the proxy-era symbols the classification derives by its own scan; there is no constant of the name, the docblock names the derived set

entries.name: MAX_TOMBSTONE_PATH
entries.reason: History: the docblock says the one bound a peer's path had before the fix was the tombstone's, a constant since removed; the sentence describes the defect the test was written for

entries.name: NAMED_INSTANCES
entries.reason: History: the docblock says what the version it replaces named, a list the rewrite deleted; the sentence describes the defect the test was written for

entries.name: SECRET_PATTERNS
entries.reason: History: the docblock lists the three copies of the secret-pattern families that the one list replaced; the replaced copies are gone by design

entries.name: DISCARDED_BY_DESIGN
entries.reason: The name the docblock gives an exemption class of the gate; the gate holds the class as a `discarded` flag on a site, and no constant has the name
